tags: @guarantee ok.predefined-periodic The predefined expressions are equivalent to these six-field expressions: "@yearly" to "0 0 0 1 1 *", "@monthly" to "0 0 0 1 * *", "@weekly" to "0 0 0 * * 0", "@daily" to "0 0 0 * * *", "@hourly" to "0 0 * * * *", "@minutely" to "0 * * * * *" and "@secondly" to "* * * * * *".
@guarantee ok.predefined-weekdays-weekends "@weekdays" is equivalent to "0 0 0 * * 1-5" (every weekday at midnight) and "@weekends" is equivalent to "0 0 0 * * 0,6" (every weekend at midnight).
@guarantee ok.sunday-zero-or-seven In the day of week field the values `0` and `7` both mean Sunday, and the alias "SUN" means Sunday.

@guarantee ok.start-date-as-current-date When `currentDate` is not provided but `startDate` is, `startDate` is used as `currentDate`, so "2023-01-01T00:00:00Z" given as `startDate` becomes the `currentDate`.

@guarantee ok.current-date-clamped-to-start A `currentDate` before `startDate` is clamped to `startDate`: with `currentDate` "2022-01-01T00:00:00Z" and `startDate` "2023-01-01T00:00:00Z" the current date becomes "2023-01-01T00:00:00Z".
@guarantee err.strict-day-of-month-and-week With `strict` set to true, parsing "0 0 12 1-31 * 1" throws an error with the message "Cannot use both dayOfMonth and dayOfWeek together in strict mode!".
@guarantee err.strict-requires-six-fields With `strict` set to true, parsing the five-field expression "0 20 15 * *" throws an error with the message "Invalid cron expression, expected 6 fields".

@guarantee err.strict-hash-step-wider-than-range With `strict` set to true, parsing "0 H(1-5)/10 * * * *" throws an error with the message "Invalid step: 10, wider than the 1-5 range of the minute field".

@guarantee err.next-beyond-end-date When the next date would exceed `endDate`, `next` throws an error with the message "Out of the time span range"; for "0 0 * * *" with `currentDate` "2023-12-31T00:00:00Z" and `endDate` "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z" the first call returns a date and the second call throws.
@guarantee ok.next-within-end-date For "0 0 * * *" with `currentDate` "2023-12-31T00:00:00Z" and `endDate` "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", the first call of `next` returns a date without throwing.
@guarantee ok.take-count `take` with a limit of 3 returns an array of the next 3 dates, and `take` with a limit of 5 returns an array of the next 5 dates.

@guarantee ok.hash-seed-deterministic Parsing "H * * * H" with `hashSeed` "main-backup" gives an expression whose `stringify` is "12 * * * 4", and parsing it again with the same `hashSeed` gives the same "12 * * * 4".

@guarantee ok.override-raw-values Starting from the fields of "0 7 * * 1-5" and overriding `hour` with [8], `minute` with [30] and `dayOfWeek` with [1, 3, 5], the result stringifies to "30 8 * * 1,3,5".

@guarantee ok.override-field-instances Starting from the fields of "0 7 * * 1-5" and overriding `hour` with a CronHour of [15] and `minute` with a CronMinute of [30], the result stringifies to "30 15 * * 1-5" and the `dayOfWeek` field is unchanged.
@guarantee ok.parse-file-result-shape `parseFile` resolves to a result object with the properties `variables`, `expressions` and `errors`.
@guarantee ok.parse-file-sync-result-shape `parseFileSync` returns a result object with the properties `variables`, `expressions` and `errors`.
